Make ONLY a tiny polite chin-down acknowledgment nod, moving head/hair/headband together about ONE logical pixel lower, keeping original head size and width. All body pixels below the collar including arms, hands, waist, trousers, feet must remain faithful and stationary. Preserve hard chunky LPC pixel shapes and source palette, four-image-pixel grid, transparent background and generous margins. Same 3:1 proportions as the 768x256 reference. No new details, text, labels, props, weapons, shadows, floor or base. Minor dialogue animation edit, never attack or spell.
